answer: Bridge-Census Routing. Each agent must be reachable through at least three distinct relay neighborhoods that record it independently; a node appearing only on one neighborhood's adjacency is flagged. Relays exchange signed neighborhood digests, and an agent's reachability window is the intersection of its listings, so a duplicate has to place a distinct crystal of consistent history in every neighborhood it claims. Attacker cost: one genuine relay presence plus corroborating latency and pigment of distinct traffic per copy, scaling linearly with each sybil instance rather than paying once.
